MLA Standard: MLA.CHEM.BON.01

Stimulus:

Atom pairValence evidenceAttraction evidence
Na and ClNa has 1 valence electron; Cl has 7Na+ and Cl- attract after electron transfer
H and HEach H has 1 valence electronBoth nuclei attract a shared electron pair

Question: Which answer avoids the common misconception for this topic?

generalfeedback.text: Use the embedded stimulus first, then connect the evidence to the bonding, formula, property, or nomenclature rule.

answer.text: Bonding occurs only when atoms become electrically neutral before any attraction occurs.

feedback.text: This does not fully meet MLA.CHEM.BON.01. 'Bonding occurs only when atoms become electrically neutral before any attraction occurs.' may sound related, but it misses the key bonding, structure, polarity, or intermolecular-force evidence required by the question. Compare it with 'Valence electrons are central because they are the outer electrons involved in bonding.', which better fits the evidence and wording of the prompt.
